about: Sign-offs for the release gate (edakit gate). Each one counts only for the hash of its scope: 'circuit' = state_sha256 (graph, parts database, simulation config), 'layout' = layout_sha256 (layout files, footprint geometry). When something there changes, it no longer counts – copy the new hash from the protocol header after the check was repeated. phase: 'export' blocks the release, 'order' and 'acceptance' come after the export. An accepted warning with scope 'decision' counts regardless of the hash and refers to a numbered decision in the docs. Parts are signed in their parts entry (field 'verified').

manual.text: Critical parts (U1 Nano pinout, C1 polarity, the LEDs, J1 servo pinout) checked a second time independently against datasheet and footprint – e.g. by the agent electrical-reviewer
manual.note: OK for state d04ade33… (delta to 136762d8…: base load R8/R9, i_min_a). R8/R9 0.18–0.25 W of 0.5 W derated; USB 123–177 mA idle to warning, 410–422 mA bell, lowest +5V 4.245 V. Open text fixes for the next circuit change (D-7): sim.json stall note 725 -> ~810 mA, C35218 footprint note (R2512 confirmed).

manual.text: Layout reviewed independently (manufacturability; mechanics: the Nano's USB at the edge; operation of the buttons; looks of the LED row) on the manufacturing files of a gate run – e.g. by the agent pcb-reviewer
manual.done_by: agent pcb-reviewer (Claude, independent session) + Gerber measurement

manual.text: At JLCPCB after the upload: assembly preview (buttons, resistors), BOM without missing parts, price
Acceptance of every delivered board: visual check, Nano plugged in, current through USB, every LED, both buttons, the servo swings
